angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 638,653 km at 157.17 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.3626 +/- 0.0132 mas (same row, RUWE 0.83): 157.17 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.918 +/- 0.038 solar radii from Davis et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-905 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..229D/abstract): 638,653 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.968 +/- 0.061 solar masses from Davis et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-905 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..229D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5570 +/- 150 K from Davis et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-905 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..229D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Davis et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-905 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..229D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-905.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.498, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-905: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-905 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Davis et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..229D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-905 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.13668, from Davis et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..229D/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-905 (pscomppars): age 3.4 Gyr, from Davis et al. 2020 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..229D/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
